constraints: Dual-core Xtensa LX6 at up to 240 MHz; no hardware FPU for double precision, so INT8 quantization is required for practical inference.
520 KB total SRAM is shared with WiFi/BT stacks and application code; tensor arena must be sized well below total RAM.
No native NPU/DSP acceleration; all inference runs on the CPU via TFLite Micro kernels.
